title: Data Contract Template
description: A contract skeleton (ownership, schema, semantics, SLA, compatibility policy) with the CI check that enforces it and a deprecation checklist.
repo_structure:
data-contract-template/
  contract.yaml        # owner, sla, semantics, policy
  schema.avsc          # typed schema
  ci/check-compat.sh   # compatibility gate
  DEPRECATION.md       # dated deprecation path
